label: batch-2
tail:
Completed batch 2’s A/B pages, item inventory, proof contracts, source coverage and cross-batch evidence. I added a local lemma proving the Itô finite-sum identity for square-integrable step coefficients, and updated the interpolation definition and moment proof to use it. The algorithm accepts any finite uniform grid; the moment estimates specify \(0<h\le1\).

The files are [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-2.notes.md), [page manifest](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-2.pages.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-2.coverage.json), [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-2.proof-contracts.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/bayesian-computational-statistics-62-batch-2.cross-batch-dependencies.json).

**Checks:** all five proof-bearing items passed precheck; proof layout found 0 defects across 6 changed items and 16 steps. Focused dependency, content-policy and render checks passed. The batch’s 7 item levels recomputed without errors; all 4 source URLs passed `source-fetch-check --stamp`. Coverage records [Higham–Mao–Stuart](https://www.maths.ed.ac.uk/~dhigham/Publications/P44.pdf), [Särkkä–Solin](https://users.aalto.fi/~asolin/sde-book/sde-book.pdf), [Li’s lecture notes](https://www.math.pku.edu.cn/teachers/litj/notes/appl_stoch/lect15.pdf), and [van der Vaart’s notes](https://diamhomes.ewi.tudelft.nl/~avandervaart/books/stochint.pdf).

**Handoff:** all 7 Step‑1 decisions are escalated, with `owner: false` and hashes matching the current carriers. The required `forward-ito-sde-well-posedness` page remains unresolved: its four proof carriers return `bad-tag(steps 1.1)`, `untagged-steps`, `repair` (not a clean pass), and `untagged-steps`; its batch‑1 proof-contract file is absent. The stored run-wide batch-dependency artifact is stale after the manifest change; recomputation still gives batch 2 level 1, requiring batch 1. I left that shared artifact for the owner to regenerate. The run-wide item-level check also reports empty scaffolds in other batches; the assigned batch’s levels pass.

One validation-usage note: I mistakenly invoked `depcheck --help`, which triggered a read-only whole-corpus scan; I discarded its result and used the focused batch-2 check. An initial Step‑1 recording attempt that included the page slug encountered invalid YAML (`\lambda`) in the unrelated [thm-hh-affine-type-a-bernstein-pbw.md](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-hh-affine-type-a-bernstein-pbw.md). I left that file untouched; the final records use item dependencies and state the page-level blocker in their reasons.
